_doc: AortaCFD config reference v2.3 - Profiles: robust/standard/precise

_naming_convention._rule: snake_case for app params, camelCase for OpenFOAM dict keys
_naming_convention._tip: When in doubt, check examples/ or use snake_case

_cardiac_cycle_comment: Top-level cardiac cycle period in seconds (alternative to simulation_control.cardiac_cycle_period)

physics._model_notes: laminar: No turbulence; rans/rans_komegasst: RANS k-omega SST; les: LES WALE. Use lowercase.
physics._simulation_type_comment: OpenFOAM simulation type. Auto-set from model, or override explicitly.

transport_properties._nu_comment: Kinematic viscosity in m²/s = mu/rho (typical blood: 3.77e-6 m²/s). Dynamic viscosity mu = nu * rho = 0.004 Pa·s

numerics._comment: Numerical schemes and solver settings using 3-profile system

_profile_descriptions.robust: Maximum stability (1st order, Euler, upwind) - for difficult meshes/debugging
_profile_descriptions.standard: Balanced accuracy/stability (2nd order TVD bounded) - recommended for production
_profile_descriptions.precise: Minimal diffusion (LUST, CrankNicolson) - for LES, validation, convergence studies

numerics._adjustable_timestep_comment: Enable adaptive time stepping based on Courant number

relaxation_factors._comment: Under-relaxation factors (override profile defaults if needed)

residual_control._comment: Convergence tolerances (override profile defaults if needed)

mesh._cells_per_diameter_comment: Cells across inlet diameter. Can also use mesh.mesh_resolution.cells_per_diameter

_alternative_location._comment: cells_per_diameter can also be specified as:

boundary_layers._comment: Boundary layer (prism/inflation) settings - traditional OpenFOAM addLayersControls style
boundary_layers._num_layers_comment: Number of prism layers (nSurfaceLayers). Standard: 10 (SimVascular default), Minimum: 5, Fine: 12-15
boundary_layers._expansion_ratio_comment: Growth ratio between successive layers (typical: 1.15-1.25, SimVascular default: 1.2)
boundary_layers._final_layer_thickness_comment: Final (outermost) layer thickness as fraction of local cell size (when relativeSizes=true)
boundary_layers._min_thickness_comment: Minimum layer thickness as fraction of cell size. Allows graceful collapse in tight regions.
boundary_layers._relativeSizes_comment: If true, layer thicknesses are relative to local cell size. If false, thicknesses are absolute in meters.

_relativeSizes_options.true: Thicknesses as fraction of local cell size (DEFAULT, recommended)
_relativeSizes_options.false: Thicknesses as absolute values in meters

volume_refinement._enabled_comment: Enable volume refinement in specific regions

quality_controls._comment: Mesh quality thresholds (override base.py defaults if needed)

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._parallel_comment: Enable parallel meshing (recommended for large cases)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._span_refinement_enabled_comment: Enable insideSpan mode for guaranteed cells across diameter
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._cells_across_span_comment: Minimum cells across vessel diameter at every cross-section
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._span_refinement_level_comment: Max refinement levels for span mode (USE 1 or 2 ONLY - level 3 causes mesh failure!)

_span_refinement_level_validated.study: Validated by 26-test span refinement study (23/24 passed)

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._surfaceRefinementLevels_comment: Surface refinement levels [min, max] for snappyHexMesh

_surfaceRefinementLevels_options.[0, 1]: No subdivision: base cell size at surface
_surfaceRefinementLevels_options.[1, 2]: One subdivision: 2× finer at surface - DEFAULT

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._includedAngle_comment: Feature edge detection angle (180-angle = feature threshold). 170 = detect edges >10°. Range: 120-170.
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._featureLevel_comment: Feature edge refinement level (single integer). Auto-calculated from max(surfaceRefinementLevels) if not set.
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._resolveFeatureAngle_comment: snappyHexMesh feature resolution angle (degrees). Lower = more features captured. Range: 20-60.

geometry._comment: Geometry patch definitions (auto-discovered from STL files)
geometry._scale_factor_comment: Geometry scale factor (0.001 = mm to m)
geometry._reference_radius_strategy_comment: How to determine reference radius for mesh sizing. 'inlet' uses inlet patch radius, 'minimum' uses smallest vessel radius, 'average' uses mean radius.

_type_descriptions.CONSTANT: Uniform plug flow (specify velocity or cardiac_output)
_type_descriptions.MRI: Pre-processed 4D flow MRI inlet data (OpenFOAM format)

_CONSTANT_parameters._cardiac_output_comment: Cardiac output in L/min (alternative to velocity)
_CONSTANT_parameters._cardiac_output_note: If specified, velocity is calculated from CO and inlet area

_TIMEVARYING_parameters._csv_file_comment: CSV file with flow data (in cases_input/<case>/)
_TIMEVARYING_parameters._data_type_comment: Type of data in CSV column 2

_data_type_units.flowrate: L/min (auto-detected if max > 1.0, converted to m³/s internally)

_TIMEVARYING_parameters._csv_units_note: Clinical flowrate data should be in L/min (e.g., 0.5-5.0 L/min for adults). System auto-detects and converts.

_profile_descriptions.elliptical: Elliptical Poiseuille (auto-fits ellipse to inlet geometry)
_profile_descriptions.wall_distance: Distance-to-wall based profile (for irregular inlets like aortic root with valve leaflets)

_TIMEVARYING_parameters._exponent_comment: For wall_distance profile: 2.0 = parabolic-like, 1.0 = linear, 0.143 (1/7) = turbulent

_WOMERSLEY_parameters._n_harmonics_comment: Number of Fourier harmonics for Womersley profile. 'auto' = FFT-based spectral energy detection (99% threshold)

_MRI_parameters._description: Use pre-processed 4D flow MRI data directly (no profile mapping)
_MRI_parameters._use_case: When spatially resolved inlet velocities from 4D flow MRI are available
_MRI_parameters._file_comment: Path to directory containing time directories with U files

_data_format.U_file_format: OpenFOAM vectorField format (one velocity vector per inlet face)
_data_format.cardiac_cycle: Auto-detected from max time directory name

_workflow: 1. System copies time directories to constant/boundaryData/<inlet_patch>/
2. Points file is generated from mesh inlet patch faces
3. CycleDataSetup creates symlinks for additional cardiac cycles
4. No velocity profile mapping or interpolation is performed

_current_config._profile_comment: Flow profile shape - parabolic recommended for laminar aortic flow

_type_descriptions.zeroGradient: Zero gradient (outflow) - simplest, no pressure specification
_type_descriptions.2EWINDKESSEL: 2-element Windkessel model (R-C, Z=0) - for steady/CONSTANT flow

_fixedValue_parameters._pressure_pa_comment: Fixed outlet pressure in Pascals (converted to kinematic: p/rho)

_MODE_1_clinical_calculation._description: Calculate R, C, Z from clinical parameters (DEFAULT)

_MODE_2_direct_rcz._description: Provide R, C, Z directly (skips all calculation)
_MODE_2_direct_rcz._note: If outlet_parameters has R, C, Z for ALL outlets, clinical calculation is skipped

windkessel_settings._systolic_pressure_comment: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg (typical adult: 110-130)
windkessel_settings._diastolic_pressure_comment: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg (typical adult: 70-85)
windkessel_settings._tau_comment: Diastolic decay time constant in seconds (typical: 1.5-2.5)
windkessel_settings._pwv_comment: Fixed PWV value in m/s (if pwv_method='fixed', typical aorta: 4-10)
windkessel_settings._pwv_b_comment: PWV formula parameter 'b' (MATLAB formula: c = a/(2√(A/π))^b)
windkessel_settings._compliance_distribution_comment: How to distribute compliance across outlets

_flow_split_options._option_1_null: null = automatic Murray's law for all outlets
_flow_split_options._option_5_note: Fixed % for some outlets, Murray's law for rest

windkessel_settings._coupling_mode_comment: Implicit adds source terms to momentum (recommended for stability)
windkessel_settings._stabilization_formulation: Two-parameter directional stabilization: F = H(-φ) × [βN·n⊗n + βT·(I - n⊗n)]
windkessel_settings._betaT_comment: Tangential damping coefficient (0-1). Suppresses spurious vortices during backflow.

_betaT_guidelines.0.0: No tangential damping - use only for validation/comparison
_betaT_guidelines.0.2: Mild damping - for cases with minimal backflow
_betaT_guidelines.0.3: Recommended - good balance of stability and physics preservation
_betaT_guidelines.0.5: Strong damping - for severe backflow or difficult geometries

windkessel_settings._betaN_comment: Normal damping coefficient (0-1). Keep at 0.0 to preserve Windkessel P-Q coupling.

_betaN_guidelines.0.0: RECOMMENDED - allows normal velocity to respond to Windkessel pressure
_betaN_guidelines.0.05: Emergency - only if βT alone cannot stabilize
_betaN_guidelines.0.1: Maximum safe - beyond this distorts Windkessel physics

windkessel_settings._betaN_warning: Setting βN > 0 constrains normal velocity during backflow, fighting against Windkessel pressure

_initial_pressure_method_descriptions.diastolic: Start at diastolic pressure (DEFAULT, recommended for start-of-cycle initialization)
_initial_pressure_method_descriptions.systolic: Start at systolic pressure (use if simulation starts at peak systole)
_initial_pressure_method_descriptions.zero: Start at zero pressure (not physiological, for debugging only)

outlets._rho_comment: Blood density in kg/m³ (for modularWKPressure kinematic conversion)

_moving_wall_parameters._velocity_comment: Wall velocity vector for moving walls

simulation_control._comment: Simulation time control and output settings
simulation_control._end_time_comment: Simulation end time in seconds (or cardiac cycles)
simulation_control._cardiac_cycle_period_comment: Duration of one cardiac cycle in seconds (for pulsatile flow)
simulation_control._number_of_cycles_comment: Number of cardiac cycles to simulate
simulation_control._delta_t_comment: Initial time step in seconds (adaptive if adjustable_timestep=true)
simulation_control._writeInterval_comment: Write interval in seconds (how often to save results)
simulation_control._write_format_comment: Output file format (binary is faster and smaller)
simulation_control._purge_write_comment: Keep only last N time directories (0 = keep all)

functions._comment: Post-processing functions to compute during simulation

wallShearStress._comment: Compute wall shear stress on specified patches

probes._comment: Sample field values at specific locations

run_settings._solution_type_comment: Run in serial or parallel mode
run_settings._subdomains_comment: Number of parallel subdomains (cores to use)
run_settings._decomposition_method_comment: Domain decomposition method (scotch is usually best)

decomposition_coeffs._n_comment: For 'simple' method: number of divisions in x,y,z

hemodynamics._description: Configure WSS, TAWSS, OSI, RRT computation during simulation

runtime_functions._wallShearStress_comment: Compute WSS at wall patches every writeTime
runtime_functions._pressureMonitoring_comment: Area-averaged pressure at inlet and outlets for pressure drop calculation

tawss_settings._comment: Time-averaged WSS settings (only for pulsatile flow)
tawss_settings._skip_cycles_comment: Skip initial N cardiac cycles before averaging (allow transients to decay)
tawss_settings._periodicRestart_comment: Restart averaging each cardiac cycle (for per-cycle TAWSS convergence check)
tawss_settings._periodicRestart_note: If false, accumulates over entire simulation after skip_cycles
tawss_settings._keep_all_cycles_comment: Keep TAWSS data from all cycles (for convergence analysis)

_output_fields.wallShearStress: Instantaneous WSS vector at wall patches

_derived_metrics.TAWSS: Time-Averaged Wall Shear Stress = mean(|WSS|) over cardiac cycle

_notes: WSS computed for ALL inlet types (CONSTANT and pulsatile)
TAWSS/OSI/RRT only meaningful for pulsatile flow
For CONSTANT inlet: OSI=0, RRT=1/TAWSS (no oscillation)

post_processing._compute_hemodynamics_comment: Calculate hemodynamic indices (WSS, OSI, RRT) from simulation data

pressure_drop._comment: Calculate pressure drop from inlet to outlets

advanced._comment: Advanced options (most users don't need to modify)

custom_templates._comment: Use custom Jinja2 templates for boundary conditions

manual_mesh_refinement._comment: Use custom topoSet dictionary for manual refinement

mesh_quality_validation._comment: UNDER DEVELOPMENT: Mesh quality validation utilities (src/aortacfd_lib/utils/mesh_quality.py)

_quality_tiers.EXCELLENT: All metrics within strict tolerances - production ready
_quality_tiers.GOOD: Minor issues - acceptable for most simulations
_quality_tiers.FAIR: Some concerns - may need robust profile
_quality_tiers.CRITICAL: Major problems - simulation will likely fail

_grid_convergence_index._comment: Richardson extrapolation for mesh independence studies
_grid_convergence_index._safety_factor_comment: GCI safety factor (1.25 for 3+ meshes, 3.0 for 2 meshes)

visualization._fields_comment: Fields to visualize. TAWSS/OSI/RRT require hemodynamics post-processing first.
visualization._time_steps_comment: 'last' for final timestep, 'all' for every saved time, or list of specific times

color_ranges._comment: Fixed color ranges for consistent visualization (auto-scale if not specified)
color_ranges._TAWSS_comment: Time-averaged WSS [Pa]. Low <0.4 Pa indicates atherogenic risk
color_ranges._OSI_comment: Oscillatory shear index [-]. High >0.3 indicates disturbed flow
color_ranges._RRT_comment: Relative residence time [1/Pa]. High >10 indicates particle trapping

_usage_notes.3_profile_selection: Use 'robust' for difficult meshes, 'standard' for production, 'precise' for LES/validation
_usage_notes.5_boundary_layers: Use 10 layers (SimVascular standard), 1.2 expansion ratio. Increase to 12-15 for fine resolution
_usage_notes.6_windkessel: Leave flow_split=null for automatic Murray's law distribution
_usage_notes.7_simulation_time: Run at least 3-5 cardiac cycles for pulsatile flow
_usage_notes.8_parallel: Use 4-8 cores for medium cases, more for large geometries
_usage_notes.9_inlet_profile: Use 'parabolic' for circular inlets, 'wall_distance' for irregular inlets (e.g., aortic root)
_usage_notes.10_womersley: Use n_harmonics='auto' for automatic spectral energy-based harmonic selection
_usage_notes.11_mri_inlet: Use type='MRI' with file='./inlet/' for pre-processed 4D flow MRI inlet data (no profile mapping)
